D-001.rationale: Gradients summed (not averaged) under PP+GAS produce grad_norm proportional to gradient_accumulation_steps; Tier 1 grad_norm directly captures the scaling anomaly.

D-002.rationale: ZeRO-2 backward regression manifests as systematically lower grad_norm (4.7-6.0 -> 1.6-3.2); Tier 1 gradient stats sufficient.

D-003.rationale: Cross-DP-rank gradient checksum divergence on cross-partition params after reduce_scatter; Tier 1 grad checksum + DP rank coordinate suffice.

D-004.rationale: DistributedAttention SeqAllToAll uneven-split error propagates to attention output and downstream gradients; grad_norm deviates from reference at Tier 1 (forward activations themselves are op-level).

D-005.rationale: CPUAdam IncrementStep produces inconsistent bias_correction2 across subgroups within the same step — directly visible in Adam optimizer state checksum at Tier 4.

D-006.rationale: Int32 overflow makes CUDA kernel skip updates; param checksum stays unchanged across steps for large tensors — pure Tier 0 detection.

D-007.rationale: loss_scale=inf produces NaN gradients; reliable detection requires has_nan flag (Tier 5-6). grad_norm becomes NaN but the canonical signal is the NaN flag.

D-008.rationale: Dropout RNG mismatch under torch.compile causes loss to slowly diverge (6.09 vs 5.12 over 40k steps); Tier 2 loss trend captures this. Activation values are op-level.

D-009.rationale: ZeRO-3 overwrites user-defined module.id attribute on MoE experts; module attribute snapshot is a Type-B hook output (Tier 5-6 per mapping).

D-010.rationale: Multiple-backward gradients dropped under CPU offload causes ~2x learning_rate parameter deviation vs reference; Tier 0 param checksum cross-config compare suffices.

D-012.rationale: Grad_norm fails to grow across microsteps under CPU offload; Tier 1 grad_norm trend across micro_step_id (Tier 3) — but grad_norm freeze itself observable as Tier 1 anomaly without strict need for micro_step_id.

D-013.rationale: Two bugs both manifest in grad_norm: dynamic loss scale shrinks bf16 grads catastrophically AND grad zeroing skipped causes grad_norm to grow unboundedly — Tier 1.

D-016.rationale: Gradient clipping records norm inconsistent with actual clipped grad value; Tier 1 grad_norm + grad checksum mismatch.

D-017.rationale: micro_step_id off-by-one causes gradient copy/accumulate condition errors at micro-batch boundaries; Tier 3 micro_step_id is the canonical signal (matches few-shot 4).

D-018.rationale: MoE param's _hp_mapping=None is a module attribute / structural fingerprint; Tier 5-6 (module attribute snapshot per mapping). Crash-on-save would be detectable but pre-crash invariant is attribute-level.

D-019.rationale: MoE EP grad_scale wrong by ep_size factor — directly visible in grad_norm of expert params at Tier 1 (ep_rank used to scope).

D-020.rationale: LayerNorm backward CUDA kernel uses wrong index for gamma — gamma gradient checksum diverges from reference at Tier 1.

D-022.rationale: Wrong sort order during universal-checkpoint conversion silently corrupts optimizer state; Tier 4 optimizer state checksum mismatch vs original.

D-023.rationale: Adam bias correction inconsistent across subgroups within same step — Tier 4 optimizer state checksum (analogous to D-005).

D-024.rationale: ds_secondary_tensor stale after checkpoint load — its checksum mismatches ds_tensor; Tier 0 cross-buffer param checksum compare.

D-028.rationale: BF16 gradient allreduced instead of FP32 buffer — dtype mismatch on the reduced tensor is observable at Tier 0 dtype field.

D-030.rationale: ZeRO-3 ignores configured comm dtype; allgather/reduce-scatter tensor dtype mismatches config — Tier 0 dtype check.

D-031.rationale: MoE gate.wg gradient never reduced — Tier 1 grad checksum across DP ranks shows gate.wg grads diverge while other params agree.

D-032.rationale: Multi-machine stage3 universal checkpoint load corrupts state — loss spikes after resume; Tier 2 loss_value discontinuity at resume.

D-033.rationale: bf16+ZeRO0 checkpoint loses optimizer step counter, exp_avg, exp_avg_sq — directly visible in Adam state checksum (zero-valued) at Tier 4.

D-034.rationale: Sequence-parallel gradient scaling errors and bf16 SP-reduce precision loss show up as grad_norm trend (SP=2 lower than SP=1; growth over time) — Tier 1.

D-035.rationale: ZeRO-3 grad norm not allreduced across DP — different ranks observe different grad_norm; Tier 1 cross-DP grad_norm equality check.

D-036.rationale: bf16 optimizer fails to convert grads to FP32 when accum dtype differs — gradient/buffer dtype mismatch observable at Tier 0.

D-037.rationale: Gate linear-layer params silently cast to fp32 in forward (was fp16/bf16) — dtype-invariance violation at Tier 0 catches this; aux-loss formula bug also produces grad_norm ratio issue but dtype is lower-tier.

D-039.rationale: reduce_bucket_size silently affects convergence — different bucket sizes yield different loss curves (extreme small => NaN). Tier 2 loss trend captures the divergence.

D-041.rationale: Checkpoint dir name's step != internal global_step counter — pure Tier 0 step counter consistency check.

D-042.rationale: Coalesced all-gather under autocast contains parameters with mixed dtypes — Tier 0 dtype field directly captures the mixture.

D-043.rationale: MiCS checkpoint missing data from non-first partition group — Tier 0 param_name enumeration across DP ranks shows missing params.

D-044.rationale: Multi-process race in stage3 universal checkpoint write produces unstable optimizer state checksum across save attempts; Tier 4 detects via cksum non-determinism.

D-045.rationale: Grad accumulation buffer forced to BF16 instead of FP32 — Tier 0 dtype field on grad_accum buffer catches it.

D-046.rationale: MoE checkpoint only saves rank-0 model_states under TP>1; missing param_name entries on non-zero TP ranks at save time — Tier 0 enumeration.

M-001.rationale: Embedding gradient cksum differs between PP[0] and PP[-1] within same DP group — Tier 1 grad checksum + rank coords.

M-002.rationale: CP attention backward produces dQ/dK/dV with relative error >1.0 vs single-card; grad_norm on attention params deviates significantly — Tier 1.

M-003.rationale: Loss multiplied by cp_size in backward scales gradients by cp_size factor — directly visible in grad_norm at Tier 1.

M-004.rationale: MTP loss un-normalized causes gradient explosion; grad_norm spikes — Tier 1 (loss_value also spikes, but grad_norm is the more direct signal at lower tier).

M-006.rationale: Uneven vocab split under TP causes loss to diverge (abs error 47 after 2000 steps) — Tier 2 loss_value cross-config compare.

M-007.rationale: Stale all-gather causes some ranks to use previous-iteration's weights; cur-step param checksum matches step-1 checksum — pure Tier 0.

M-009.rationale: SP+FlashAttn skips q/k/v all-gather causing attention only on local chunk; downstream gradient checksum on attention params diverges from non-SP reference at Tier 1 (raw activations are op-level).

M-011.rationale: RoPE buffer values for positions 0..N-1 are computed regardless of the configured reset behavior; the buffer tensor is an op-level intermediate not in the parameter/grad/loss/optstate trace schema.

M-013.rationale: Aux load-balancing loss is constantly 1.0 instead of varying — Tier 2 loss_value (specifically aux loss component) reveals the constant pattern.

M-015.rationale: Override-opt_param-scheduler ignored; LR retains old checkpoint value — Tier 3 learning_rate field directly catches the mismatch.

M-016.rationale: Optimizer offload + checkpoint resume causes loss to jump 0.31 -> 10 — Tier 2 loss_value discontinuity at resume.

M-017.rationale: mcore-0.12 checkpoint resume can't reproduce pre-save loss — Tier 2 loss_value at first resumed step compared to pre-save.

M-018.rationale: RNG state inconsistency across DP ranks affects dropout masks (op-level activation), not directly any param/grad/loss/optstate field; downstream gradient drift is too noisy/random. RNG state itself is not in trace schema.

M-019.rationale: Embedding wgrad finishes after all-reduce so gradient missing final embedding contribution — Tier 1 grad checksum on embedding param across PP ranks.

M-022.rationale: Wrong scale variable (mscale vs mscale_all_dim) in MLA softmax_factor is an op-level scalar inside the attention kernel; downstream loss/grad differ slightly but not distinguishably from numerical noise. Source-only.

M-023.rationale: PP p2p tensor shape doesn't account for CP — Tier 0 shape field directly catches the mismatch (or causes immediate p2p error).

M-025.rationale: Master weight initialized via wrong dtype path causes precision-loss-tainted initial values — Tier 0 param checksum compare vs reference init.

M-026.rationale: DDP buckets capture pre-init values due to stream sync miss — Tier 0 param checksum compare between source param and DDP bucket buffer.

M-027.rationale: int32 overflow in dataloader sample_idx produces wrong document indices — dataloader internal state, explicitly listed unobservable per tier mapping.

M-028.rationale: RoPE position-embedding values per CP rank — these are op-level forward-pass tensors not in parameter/grad/loss/optstate schema. Source-only.

M-029.rationale: torch.compile recompile breaks autograd graph in PPO loop, c10d::broadcast_ produces silently wrong gradients — Tier 1 cross-DP grad checksum divergence.

M-030.rationale: First step after resume uses old LR instead of new override — Tier 3 learning_rate value at resumed step (similar to M-015).

M-031.rationale: MXFP8 grad buffer reuse race produces NaN loss — has_nan flag (Tier 5-6) is the canonical signal; grad_norm becomes NaN/inf indistinguishably.

M-032.rationale: MLA implementation produces unexpected loss patterns — Tier 2 loss_value cross-version compare.

M-034.rationale: Stream-sync race between DDP post-hook and reduce-scatter — Tier 1 cross-DP grad checksum divergence.

M-035.rationale: TE fused attention backward produces dQ with relative error >1.0; grad_norm on attention params abnormally large — Tier 1.

M-036.rationale: TE silently uses causal mask ignoring block-diagonal mask for packed sequences — attention output difference is op-level activation not in trace schema; gradient/loss differences are confounded with content. Source-only.

M-037.rationale: YarnRoPE freq layout mismatch with rotary_interleaved=True — RoPE buffer values are op-level forward intermediates not in trace schema.

M-038.rationale: MTPLossAutoScaler under-scales MTP loss gradient by cp_size when CP enabled — Tier 1 grad_norm on MTP-related params deviates by cp_size factor.

M-039.rationale: MoE gate not sliced across TP when kv_head<tp_size — gate weight shape identical across TP ranks (should differ); Tier 0 shape field on gate param.

M-040.rationale: Grad buffer not zeroed on first iteration when forward_pre_hook disabled; pre-existing values pollute first-iter gradients — grad_norm abnormally large at step 0/1, Tier 1.

M-041.rationale: FlashSelfAttention permanently sets dropout_p=0 after eval — module attribute (dropout_p) snapshot is Type-B hook output (Tier 5-6 per mapping).

M-042.rationale: Optimizer state dict missing exp_avg key when save-interval=20 — Tier 4 optimizer state checksum (zero/missing) on first checkpoint.

O-001.rationale: Sequential block uses single shared LayerNorm (self.norm) instead of self.norm + self.norm2 — fewer LayerNorm param_names than expected; Tier 0 structural enumeration catches it (similar to M-020 silent layer drop).

O-004.rationale: Output logit norm growth with FSDP bf16 reduce — output logits are op-level forward activation, not in parameter/grad/loss schema. Loss and grad_norm remain normal per the report. Source/offline-eval only.

O-007.rationale: API param-name change makes ignore_index ineffective so padding tokens count toward loss — loss is systematically lower; Tier 2 loss_value scale mismatch.

O-008.rationale: Unsharded checkpoint save bug causes resume-loss to be discontinuous — Tier 2 loss_value at resume vs pre-save.

O-011.rationale: All transformer blocks reuse identical RoPE buffer under CP — buffer tensor checksums identical across blocks (should differ); Tier 0 cross-block param/buffer checksum equality check.

O-012.rationale: w_out param distributed only across DP, other params across DP+TP — Tier 0 param_name enumeration across rank coords reveals inconsistent sharding fingerprint.

O-013.rationale: Buggy fused CE loss produces consistently lower loss vs native PyTorch CE — Tier 2 loss_value cross-implementation compare.

O-015.rationale: Instance mask all-zero leads to divide-by-zero NaN loss; has_nan flag (Tier 5-6) is the canonical detection signal.

O-017.rationale: CosWithWarmupAndLinearDecay scheduler init produces wrong LR schedule — Tier 3 learning_rate trajectory differs from configured schedule.

O-018.rationale: ReorderedNorm + fine-grained FSDP + activation checkpointing combo produces inconsistent backward results — Tier 1 grad checksum cross-config compare.

O-019.rationale: Eval data-order drift due to dataloader bookkeeping not reset — dataloader internal state, explicitly listed unobservable per tier mapping.

O-020.rationale: SourceMixtureDataset truncates instead of randomly sampling — dataloader internal sampling state, not in trace schema. Source-only.

O-024.rationale: Self-equality check makes depth-scaled init never apply; all output projections share same scale (should vary by depth) — Tier 0 param checksum across layers reveals identical scales at init.

O-026.rationale: FSDP silently ignores load_state_dict between forward and backward — Tier 0 param checksum unchanged after load_state_dict (should change).

O-027.rationale: torch.compile CSE eliminates expressions after fsdp.set_ — affects op-level forward-pass values; manifests in activations not parameter/grad/loss/optstate checksums distinguishably. Source-only.

O-028.rationale: FSDP eval doesn't fully cast to fp32; SDPA receives mixed fp32/bf16 inputs — Tier 0 dtype field on attention input params catches inconsistency.

O-029.rationale: FSDP grad-accum outside no_sync with CPU offload overwrites instead of accumulating — Tier 1 grad checksum after multiple backward calls fails to reflect accumulation.

O-030.rationale: FSDP+PP race between reduce-scatter and grad read produces non-deterministic grad values — Tier 1 grad checksum varies across runs / across ranks.

O-031.rationale: BF16 grad accumulation unstable at >100 GPU scale — loss diverges/instability vs FP32-reduce reference at Tier 2.

O-032.rationale: Per-rank epsilon addition makes clip_coef vary with world_size — observable as grad_norm post-clip differing across world sizes for same input gradients; Tier 1 grad_norm.

O-033.rationale: FSDP use_orig_params + FULL_SHARD: inner-module state_dict misses some param names — Tier 0 param_name enumeration shows inconsistency between inner and wrapped state_dicts.
